primary_sources.title: LeetCode 322 — Coin Change
claims: The input is an integer array of coin denominations and a target amount.
The task returns the fewest number of coins needed to make the amount, or -1 when no combination can make it.
Each denomination may be used an unlimited number of times.
The observed official constraints are 1 <= coins.length <= 12, 1 <= coins[i] <= 2^31 - 1, and 0 <= amount <= 10^4.

reproducible_checks.coverage: official examples, explicit oversized-denomination boundary, and all 961 combinations of non-empty denomination subsets from {1,2,3,4,5} with amounts 0..30 compared against an independent BFS shortest-path oracle
